final: WITH per_line AS (SELECT b.budget_id, COALESCE(SUM(e.cost),0) AS total, COUNT(e.expense_id) AS cnt FROM budget b LEFT JOIN expense e ON e.link_to_budget = b.budget_id GROUP BY b.budget_id), avg_t AS (SELECT AVG(total) AS a FROM per_line) SELECT AVG(total) AS avg_total, SUM(cnt) AS total_expenses, AVG(total - (SELECT a FROM avg_t)) AS avg_excess FROM per_line WHERE total > (SELECT a FROM avg_t)
